purpose: Accelerate clean cross-circumference support using archived race-date-specific PRE tables while keeping target RESULT closed.

date_window.rule: This window may only move forward if a newer explicit finish becomes exposed; it never moves backward.

venue_pool.rule: Venue circumference must be verified by accepted Reality knowledge before support is counted.

population_selection_rule: Use whole-day Day1 blocks only, in chronological date order, from the frozen date window and venue pool.
A block enters acquisition only when an exact archive day/list href is positively observed; never derive or guess racedetail IDs by pattern.
Acquire every race in an accepted Day1 block; no cherry-picking by outcome, odds, forecast, overlap or apparent model value.
Freeze PRE membership and source/content hashes before official identity resolution for support counting.
Do not stop early merely because 30 unique supported riders is reached; preserve the intended eligible acquisition pool.
primary_historical_pre_source: KDreams archived racecard/racedetail pages reached from positively observed archive hrefs
identity_policy: Historical PRE names map to official KEIRIN.JP registration numbers under the v1 historical identity contract.
Current profile attributes are never backfilled historically.
Ambiguous, multiple, renamed or contradictory identity fails closed.
Support counts only official_registration_number x valid PRE race rows.
fallback: If safe historical raw acquisition remains unavailable, keep support unchanged and continue Sep10 Nara/Kawasaki prospective lane without lowering any gate.
